executionContract: Re-read and verify exact project owner, connected mode, revision, target item ID/ref and snapshot; stop if changed.
Re-resolve original asset ownership/readiness and source URL/metadata hash; original facts are already complete, no download/probe required.
Take private recovery snapshot of full project workspace before a write; never publish original URLs or private state.
Use canonical workspace mutation/revision checks with a single transaction to replace only matching projectAssets metadata fields. Do not use remove/reinsert for production history.
Preserve all sequence timeline items byte-for-byte, clip IDs, timing, source ranges, gains/mutes, track locks, transforms, links, URLs, project settings, unrelated JSON and financial/command history.
After mutation re-read and assert exactly one cache updated, all protected state identical, revision incremented once, and full media audit reports zero incomplete caches.
If concurrent change occurs, regenerate manifest; rollback may only restore the exact written state after current revision/snapshot verification.
residualCodeObservation: Current insertion retains an existing projectAssets entry for a matching ref. New clip facts can be correct while an old cache remains stale. A future code change should refresh only the exact owned matching asset facts and preserve unrelated asset fields, with regression coverage.
